components.gap: Supply source Ex. 4.6.1's statistical reading and definitions (Durrett p. 248). With normal(0,1) noise the Y_i are a sample from a normal population with variance 1 and unknown mean theta; the distribution of theta is called the prior distribution; P(theta in . | Y_1,...,Y_n) is called the posterior distribution after n observations, so E(theta|F_n) is its mean. Lines 256-270 use 'integrable prior variable' and 'posterior consistency claim' without these definitions, and line 266 says only that the result applies to normal (0,1) noise.
